A Mandalorian warrior is made great by his or her equipment, and each piece of Mandalorian Equipment is unique in some way.
Mandalorian items are made with customization in mind; any character making a
check to repair or modify a Mandalorian Weapon or suit of Mandalorian Armor gains a +5

bonus on the check. However, Mandalorian technology is often based on the designs of other cultures, causing some unusual interaction between technologies; if a Mandalorian item is disabled all of the modifications to that item are destroyed (and must be purchased anew, not merely repaired).
